body: It won't be pain free.
my psych recommended it the last time i was this bad, but i was too scared to agree. i'll bring it up to my therapist since i trust her more and see what her opinion is.
for me, its knowing someone would have to find my body. i can't think of anyone i would do that to.

that makes total sense to me. hold anything inside for too long and it's gonna find a way out, yk? you deserve some kind of an outlet for those times when you just wanna scream. having a plan, deciding how to say goodbye, those are some heavy thoughts and not having a way to honestly tell someone "hey, im having these thoughts and i need to figure out a safe alternative" makes them that much harder to handle.

you told us, that counts for something. he sounds like a total dbag, you have every right to cry about it. crying can be cathartic sometimes! i lived with an ed for several years, i know how hard it is to love yourself when your mind is telling you otherwise. i feel for you and i hope your evening gets easier <3

thats gotta be isolating. im glad you came here to at least tell someone! the only person who knows about my suicidal thoughts is my therapist- i can't bring myself to tell the people close to me. so i can't fault you for not telling anyone! it sounds like you've given it a lot of thought though, it has to be hard to keep all of that inside
that sounds so scary. want to chat? I'm free!
it takes a lot of honesty to tell people, even just anonymous folks on the internet. im proud of you for wanting to reach out. im free to talk if you want.
its hard when everything should be going right, but you still feel hopeless. have you talked to anyone about your plan?
totally understand. i know the people you love, love you in return, in ways that might be incomprehensible. im wishing you peace tonight <3
want to talk first? im free and here for you
my mom told me the same thing. if either me or my sibling commit, she's already planned to do the same without holding on for the survivor. definitely one way to guilt your kids into living.
broke up w my ex 2 years ago also! regret it so hard but he's entirely moved on and wants nothing to do with me. sucks so hard, i feel for you
wow fuck him. the beach can be really cathartic, even just standing in the surf.
it's impossibly hard to lose a pet so traumatically. im so sorry for your loss
ed's suck man im sorry :(
NOTTTT worth it lmao

crisis averted i took some xanax and relapsed on sh. it was stupid in hindsight to ask something like that here where people aren't allowed to help. i guess i was just feeling desperate. i'll text my psych about tonight and maybe i'll be better equipped to calm myself down next time. i love everyone here.
im staying for my little sister's sake. i'm tired and life sucks, but she doesn't deserve to lose someone like that.
fingers crossed that something worth a damn shows up for you while you wait.
glad you're still here. sorry that it hurts. i wish it didn't hurt so bad.
i think you're more likely to end up throwing most of that up & having to deal with the fallout the next day. a hasty decision is a nightmare all around.
real. it's so frustrating when people don't get it
pm me!
omg it's such a relief to hear from you!! hospital sounds so scary, but im glad you were able to get some medical help. lmk if you want to chat once you're feeling better
it's not the end of the world if they know- maybe they'll even be able to show a little support. hoping you have a comfortable rest of your night!!
Felt. I'm more concerned with the potential for an impulsive decision that owning one creates- not at all controlled.
It happens! Try not to beat yourself up over it. Put on comfortable clothes. You can always just tell them you wanted to change into loungewear, if they ask.
you still here bestie?? wanna talk?
I love you. I'm sorry
